defective.instructions: Is this screw defective? The image shows a metal screw lying on a plain background.

criteria.true: yes, the screw has a visible defect: the tip of the screw is damaged or bent, a scratch on the screw head, a scratch on the neck of the screw, damaged thread on the side of the screw, damaged thread near the top of the screw
criteria.false: no, the screw is intact and defect-free

defect_type.instructions: What kind of defect does this screw have?

criteria.manipulated_front: the tip of the screw is damaged or bent
criteria.scratch_head: a scratch on the screw head
criteria.scratch_neck: a scratch on the neck of the screw
criteria.thread_side: damaged thread on the side of the screw
criteria.thread_top: damaged thread near the top of the screw
